verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's auto-review docs cover every element of the story. You can disable reviews globally and re-enable them by keyword or label, limit them to certain branches, skip draft PRs, and pause after a set number of commits via `reviews.auto_review`. On-demand reviews are triggered with `@coderabbitai review` or `full review`, and pause, resume and ignore are also comment commands. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these trigger controls work as documented.
